title: 16395 - 16395/P0011/000017
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Mechanical Timing not correct, including Chain and/or Belt timing.
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Fuel Pump Relay (J17) (applicable for vehicles with J17 only)
technicalNotes:
When found in Engine: 4.0l W8
Kontrol edin:  TPL 2010059(RoW)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Oil Sieve in Timing Case (Camshaft Adjuster)
When found in 2008 and newer VW 2.0T engine with a timing chain (example; CCTA and CBFA), please see:
TT 01-15-08 for information about the intake camshaft, adjuster bridge and spool valve.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10174989-0001.pdf  NHTSA
